[b]Four Eyes Agreement - Westmore buys new fighter jets from Oceanice[/b]
[i]14 Feb 2027[/i]

The Westmorian Government has signed off on the procurement of 21 FK-35 joint strike fighter jets from the United States of Oceanice. The move comes as the Westmore National Guard begins to move to slowly replace the nation's aging fleet of Cyclones and Ravens. The deal was announced by Prime Minister Dwight Sharonn earlier this week on Friday, saying "Westmore's move to procure these top-of-the-line fighters will make sure we will be able to stand a fighting chance against the rapidly-changing geopolitical landscape of the world around us." 

As part of the deal with the USO, which was facilitated through the Four Eyes Agreement, New Westmore will be acquiring 21 examples of the FK-35 for a total of 7.7 billion dollars. $2.6b will be spent on the fighters themselves, and $5.1b is planned to be spent on maintenance. A further $112m will be spent by the government on acquiring the license to produce aircraft based on the FK-35's airframe, with plans to hopefully begin production on a local variant of the FK-35 by January 2029.

The deal has received pushback from members of the Progressives and Coalition. Primary among their concerns are the fact that the USO has a poor reputation in regards to sapient rights, and may still be a security threat to the region that Westmore should not be interacting with on a cordial level. Coalition leader Bryant Godfrey commented on the matter, saying "has President Sharonn forgotten the reason why the Four Eyes even existed to begin with? For the longest time, the Oceanicen were, and very likely still are, a threat to stability in Argos. We should not be giving a single penny to their backwarded regime."

Shipments of the first FK-35s are expected to begin in April later this year. Once they arrive, they will be operated by the 82 Wing of the Westmorian Air Force for testing.

[spoiler=[b][u]Nordiehim Economic News - December 2026[/u][/b]]

The blond "buisiness" man of NEC (Nordiheim Economic News) is sitting beind his desk wearing a dark grey suit, bellow him on the bottom of the screen is a stream of stock market values and resource prices scrolling past at a speed that would be a bit fast for some but fully readable for the initiated.

He starts his little news program with a slightly cocky smile.
[i]Good day to all of my fellow buisiness men and investors, today I bring you a small update on our economy and some potential juicy investment information that you might not want to miss.[/i]
A screen besides him flashes to life showing the insides of a aircraft factory were several workes are buisy doing their ting on some airframes that looks to be UAVs of some type.
[i]The stock value of Nordiheims aircraft manufacturers have seen a solid increase this year with FlyX and Airheim being the clear winners in this regard, this is in big part because of the large ordrers that they recived for new aircraft, especialy their UAVs, this have actualy resulted in Airheim anouncing their intention to expand their operations with a new aircraft plant that will be specialized in making and developing UAVs at a larger rate then their current ones.
This is a clear indication that they not only have a lot of orders but that they also expect more in the future, this clearly makes this sector a good place for some investments in the near future before the stock prices for these companies rise to high and reaches their new potential average value, some lucky investors have allready gone in to claim their own "slice of the pie" and as such this investment window will not be around for long.[/i]

The side screen now changes to a three part recording showing first the new mines in west Aboria, now being much more built up and active, before switching over to a large train hauling heavy wagons most likely containing ore before finaly showing a similar train making its stop at a large industrial complex that is most likely a refinery, it then loops and shows the same tings on repeat.
[i]A bit furter south in our nation the Datia Mining Company have now more or less compleated several of their mining complexes and are fully able to meet the production capacity of the large Midland refineries, while this means that the times of big gain investments in the Datia Mining Company is unfortunatly over there is still oportuneties both there and in Midlands refinery industry as there are still unclaimed values around that some experts belive have not been realiced yet.[/i]

With a smooth transition the side screen changes to show work being done at shipyard with a partialy made ship hull of some kind.
[i]But lets not be to blinded by the bounty of the earth, the Nordlandian company 'Nordrlandi Shipyard' have together with people from the goverment been in talks and negotiations with the goverments of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation] and [nation]BR Bob[/nation] regarding a potentialy new navy ship design, while the Hydronians have allready agreed to join into the ships designing and development the Bobians have not yet made a final decision, though some inside sources have said that they have absolutely shown interest, though despite this our goverment have allready put in a order for 6 of them to be made for testing and trial use, and not necesearly joust for themself I have heard, this means that the value of 'Nordrlandi Shipyard' is sett to potentialy start rising ones more if the ship lives up to its claims.
As such its up to who will take the investment leap first and take a chance on them succeeding with their little navy ship, remember that it is those with some courage and good "gut fealing" that will get the biggest piece of the success.[/i]

The side screen ones more changes to show mines, tough this time it is different mines in two different locations with one having jungels visible in the background while the other one is somewere dry with a large body of water far in the background.
[i]And now for that potentialy juicy investment information that I mentioned at the start of these news.[/i]
The blond man leans forward onto his desk, almoust as if he is going to wisper a secret to the viewer.
[i]A source of mine, who I trust, have told me that there might be some new trade deals in the works that will see a increase in sales of uranium and gold, as proof to back this up he presented me with reports from the mines in Ostland and Sorland about increased activity.
ehile this might not be to much a suprice when it comes to the gold mines of Ostland the uranium mines in Sorland is another matter, the local mining and refinery company there, Soranium Ltd., are not known to have their production numbers fluctuate much without a good reason.[/i]
The man sits up straith again behind his desk.
[i]This indicates expected increase in demand wich make now the perfect time to buy some of their stocks to cash in on the future increase in value, same goes for gold wether it be to invest or to have as a fall back for harder times for it will most likely also only increase in price.[/i]

With the man having said what he wanted the screen focuses on him.
[i]That is all for this time, I hope that this have been informative for you and remember what they say over in the west, "Break your leggs".[/i]
Whit this slightly cheesy and wrongly quoted idiom the blond man signs off.[/spoiler]
